# LightWebPres

> LightWebPres is a beta lightweight static publishing tool for Markdown-driven web pages and presentations.

It generates self-contained HTML intended to be readable as a scrolling page and usable as a landscape presentation. It is suitable for human-written or agent-generated content.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Fade78/lightwebpres): Source code, documentation, examples, and current release information.
